name: Number Slider
tagline: A slider, range, stepper or gauge for any number column.
summary:
Drag, step or type a number into a Whole number, Decimal, Float or Currency column, or show one as a gauge. It covers what the platform's deprecated Linear Slider, Linear Gauge and Arc Knob were used for, and adds a two-column range and a stepper.

- Five styles: a slider with a box for the exact value, a range across two columns, a stepper, and read-only bar and arc gauges
- Takes its range from the column, and ignores the platform's two-billion-wide default
- Writes once per change — when a drag is let go, per key or stepper press — snapped to the step and rounded as the column stores it
- Reads and types the user's number format, and refuses a value the column would refuse before Save does
- Colours by threshold in Fluent's status colours, and follows the form's theme, dark mode included

limitations: The demo's two columns are Decimal columns from 0 to 1,000,000, and every preset sets its own Minimum and Maximum inside that. On a form a Whole number column takes whole steps only and refuses a typed fraction, and a Currency column shows its currency symbol; neither shows here.

At rest the value box shows the number as the demo hands it over, without grouping; on a form it is the platform's own formatted value, such as $250,000.00. While dragging, both format through the user's number settings.
A read-only form, a column the user cannot edit and a range with no second column cannot be set from a preset; the screenshots show them.

presets.name: Probability with bands
presets.description: A slider from 0 to 100 in steps of 5, red to 30, amber to 70, green above. Drag it: the box follows while it moves, and getOutputs changes once, when it is let go.

presets.name: Rating in halves
presets.description: 0 to 10 in steps of 0.5. Focus the thumb and use the arrow keys — each press writes once. Type 7.25 in the box: the box takes an exact value the step would not.

presets.name: Budget
presets.description: 0 to 1,000,000 in steps of 1,000. Type 2,000,000 in the box and press Enter: it is refused with the range, and what you typed stays to be corrected; Escape puts the value back.

presets.name: Seats range
presets.description: Two columns on one track, 0 to 500. Drag one thumb into the other: it stops there. Both columns are written in one getOutputs.

presets.name: Quantity stepper
presets.description: − and + around the value, 0 to 10. Each press writes once; − switches off at 0 and + at 10. ArrowUp and ArrowDown in the box step too.

presets.name: Health bar
presets.description: A read-only bar gauge coloured by the same bands as a slider. Change the value in the property panel: the bar and the colour follow; the gauge never writes.

presets.name: Score arc
presets.description: A read-only half-circle gauge with the value in its hollow.

presets.name: Empty column
presets.description: No value yet: the thumb waits at the start, greyed, and the box is empty. Drag or type to set one; empty the box again to clear it — getOutputs gives null, not 0.

presets.name: Saved outside the range
presets.description: 150 saved on a 0–100 slider: shown as saved, the thumb at the end, a note under the field — and nothing written until you change it.
